description: This file implements a Mac-specific proxy resolver that interacts with CFNetwork to determine proxy settings for URLs, including handling PAC files and synchronizing run loop events.

classes.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
classes.description: A run loop observer that synchronizes CFNetwork proxy auto-configuration URL callbacks using a lock to prevent concurrent execution.

methods.name: GetProxyServerScheme
methods.description: Maps CFProxyType strings to ProxyServer::Scheme enums.

methods.name: ResultCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of CFNetwork proxy auto-configuration URL fetch, storing results or errors.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
methods.description: Constructor that creates a CFRunLoopObserver with specified activities.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::AddToCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Adds the observer to the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RemoveFromCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Removes the observer from the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RunLoopObserverCallBack
methods.description: Handles run loop activity callbacks, managing lock acquisition and release.

methods.name: RunLoopObserverCallBackFunc
methods.description: Forwards CFRunLoop callbacks to the SynchronizedRunLoopObserver instance.

methods.name: ProxyResolverMac::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Main method to determine proxy settings for a URL using CFNetwork, handling PAC files and synchronizing run loop events.
